items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Default light/dark token contract — Radix-style 12-step scales (base: gray / accent; status: danger / warning / success / info; each solid + alpha) following Radix's role-per-step model, with an @theme inline mapping and a single --radius scale ramp. Neutral by default; swap in your brand with theme-generator. Import after `@import "tailwindcss"`.

items.name: theme-mode
items.title: Theme Mode
items.description: Framework-agnostic light/dark/system mode controller — pre-paint init script, setMode, OS-preference sync, post-login account reconcile, plus a React useThemeMode hook.

items.name: theme-brand
items.title: Theme Brand
items.description: URL-keyed per-tenant brand theming for static SPAs — reads /t/<slug>, sets <html data-tenant>, with a pre-paint init script, route sync, and a React useThemeBrand hook. Pairs with a generated tenants.css. Independent of theme-mode (light/dark).

items.name: theme-generator
items.title: Theme Generator
items.description: Build-time CLI script (no npm publish — installed straight from this GitHub registry, lands in scripts/). Turns brand seeds into Radix-style 12-step token sets from an accent POOL: each named `accents` entry becomes a full scale (--<name>-*, bg-<name>-9 utilities) plus a [data-accent-color="<name>"] swap block that re-points --accent-* per subtree; the first key is the default accent. Semantic roles (danger/warning/success/info + custom) alias a pool scale by key or seed a private one. Pins step 9 to each seed, auto-pairs a tinted gray to the default accent, supports per-mode (light/dark) seeds, and emits per-tenant default.css drop-ins and a [data-tenant]-scoped tenants.css for the theme-brand lib, with a WCAG self-check that warns (not fails) on misses. Self-contained: ships its own vendored copy of the generate-radix-colors engine, so run it with `tsx scripts/gen-theme.ts`. Ships no themes of its own — the config is your fill-in slot.

items.description: Unstyled panel surface with inset well sections
items.docs: Well corners are meant to nest concentrically inside Root. Suggested starting point in styles.ts — root: [--panel-radius:1rem] [--panel-padding:0.25rem] rounded-(--panel-radius) p-(--panel-padding), well: rounded-[calc(var(--panel-radius)-var(--panel-padding))].
